articles.title: Day 11 of Bhotekoshi flood: Power infrastructure restoration and tunnel rescue efforts intensified
articles.summary: A devastating Bhotekoshi River flood in Nepal has severely damaged power infrastructure, prompting the Ministry of Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation to launch extensive rescue and relief operations. This natural calamity underscores the critical importance of robust disaster management and resilient infrastructure for national stability and international cooperation in such crises.

articles.title: Someone Asked Lanterns’ EP To Compare The Show To Ryan Reynolds’ Movie, And I Appreciate His Take
articles.summary: The DCU's new series, 'Lanterns', is scheduled to air as part of the 2026 TV lineup. While facing initial criticisms, some of which persist, the show's current reception is reportedly evolving. This scenario highlights how public perception can shift over time, a vital lesson for SSB aspirants in understanding audience engagement and managing narratives, whether in defence or public life.

articles.title: Harish slams Revanth over unfulfilled promises
articles.summary: Two significant national events are highlighted. West Bengal's new tourism advertisement faced public criticism and trolling over its slogan. Concurrently, in Delhi, a dramatic incident unfolded where a jilted lover abducted a minor boy and consumed poison during a 22-km police chase. These reports underscore ongoing socio-political discussions and law enforcement challenges across different Indian states.

articles.title: Who is Shardendu Tiwari, who gave up a Rs 46 lakh Amazon package to join Indian Army?
articles.summary: 27-year-old Shardendu Tiwari, despite holding lucrative civilian job offers from Amazon (worth Rs 46 lakh annually) and Airbus, chose to join the Indian Army. He is now set to be commissioned at the Officers Training Academy in Chennai. This decision highlights a growing trend of highly qualified individuals prioritizing service to the nation over high-paying corporate careers, reflecting strong patriotism and dedication.
